country.evidence_quote: Suzanne has spoken across the United States and internationally on a wide range of topics, including insect identification, sustainable pest management, biological control, and beneficial insect conservation. She also provides in-depth training on scouting. Her classes feature a vast collection of macro photography images that she has captured over many decades
